node-engineering.title: Build and Device Validation Toolchain
node-engineering.description: Repository-side tooling executes outside the Android application's runtime boundary. scripts/gradle_checks.py exposes WarningGate and main as an observed executable entrypoint. AndroidSdkSetup, NativeStages, UpgradeSigner, DeviceScreenshotReader, and ScreenshotCollector identify SDK setup, native validation stages, signing, and screenshot collection responsibilities. Gradle configuration and GitHub workflow files establish build and automation declarations; their presence does not prove a live release or deployment.
